title: APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting (first ever in Hong Kong) — day 1 of 2
source: NEWS: Hong Kong's government announced on 2025-12-12 (news.gov.hk and thestandard.com.hk) that Hong Kong hosts its first APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting in October 2026; info.gov.hk's 2026-01-23 release still says only 'October 2026'. The Oct 20-21 days are attested by SCMP's news report that Bessent may skip it ('scheduled for October 20-21 in Hong Kong', read via search summary 2026-10-19, the article itself 403s to the fetcher) and are consistent with The Standard's 2026-10-11 piece (fetched direct 2026-10-19: 'to be held in Hong Kong next week'); apec.org's annual-ministerial index (fetched direct 2026-10-19) does not yet list 2026, so no APEC or HKSAR primary names the days. Checked 2026-10-19
notes: Discovered during the apec-leaders-shenzhen-2026-11-18 pulse (2026-10-19). Day 1 of a two-day window per house convention (Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre per search summary, about 500 guests, 21 economies). The only market-relevant question is US representation: SCMP reports Bessent may skip it and Treasury's under secretary for international affairs, Erin Browne, is the leading candidate to lead the US delegation, with Bessent instead meeting Vice Premier He Lifeng in Shenzhen ahead of Trump's November visit. Estimate widens caution only; no tracked symbol is keyed to it.
